text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), the rival Duramente 
has her eye on is Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
However dire the situation, she finds a path to victory. 
Duramente rated Satono Crown highly, 
a horsegirl who grows stronger the worse the odds.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown, for her part, smiled boldly 
and said she would surpass Duramente. 
Their determination struck sparks off each other.
